Choose a new app idea

## Goal

Agree on one app your team can build in four one-week sprints and demo in five minutes on December 8.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The problem, target users, and one-sentence purpose are written down.
- [ ] The team has 3–5 core features.
- [ ] The idea is new. An app built on an idea from anyone's individual Weeks 1–6 app won't be approved and won't be graded.
- [ ] The course-required features are mapped to your app.
- [ ] The team has started an out-of-scope list.

## Where to look

Canvas: KICKOFF! Project Planning and Team Collaboration, section 1.
